items.title: Get comprehensive crop analytics
items.description: We collect comprehensive data from various sources and turn it into clear and accessible information. Analyze field history, weather conditions, and crop health to make fast and effective decisions.

items.title: Monitor crop health with satellite imagery
items.description: Forget about unnecessary field trips. Satellite crop monitoring helps track plant conditions, identify problem areas, control vegetation changes and soil moisture levels — all from your device screen.

items.title: Receive timely risk notifications
items.description: We will warn you about potential threats before they turn into serious problems. Monitor changes in vegetation condition and protect your fields and crops.

items.title: Optimize resource usage
items.description: Don't waste extra resources! Use variable rate application (VRA) maps to save on fertilizers, water, seeds, and fuel. Spend less — harvest more.

items.title: Customize individual reports
items.description: Set up individual reports for convenient access to field information. Generate and share reports with your team and partners in just a few clicks.

features.title: Top Features of Our Platform for Crop Monitoring

list.title: Remote Satellite Field Condition Monitoring
list.description: Monitor vegetation condition in different zones without going to the field. Use 10 ready-made vegetation indices to make informed decisions. Thanks to regular and high-precision Sentinel-2 and PlanetScope images without clouds and shadows, you can track crops in real time with a resolution of up to 3 m, which allows you to quickly respond to any threats.
